notes: Kept set covers body-plan evolution and novelty (skate fins, mollusc Hox, spider spinnerets and patella, fly wing GRN co-option, digits, axial formulae), GRNs and conserved noncoding elements compared across species, de novo gene origin, WGD consequences in fish and plants, early-diverging plant and chordate/deuterostome genomes, and convergent evolution and gene loss; years run 2018-2026 with 8 per year 2020-2024, 6 in 2025, 5 in 2026 and only 4 for 2018-2019 because the shortlist has no 2016-2017 items and few 2018-2019 ones. It is WGD- and plant-genome-heavy and lacks experimental enhancer-level cis-regulatory evolution (enhancer swaps, Pitx1-type cases), early-branching animals (sponges, cnidarians, ctenophores) and vertebrate craniofacial/limb enhancer studies, none of which the shortlist offered.
